Author: Ferrante, Elena
Title:
Czas porzucenia
My Brilliant Friend
The Story of a New Name
Those Who Leave And Those Who Stay
The Story of the Lost Child
Comment:
recommended by: Simon
Kuddos for the titles of the big Four. The first one - high literature, the second more boring, the third: a straight up gossip book, the forth: old age synthesis rather than a story (which is impressive in the end). All filled with niuanse & largely immersive; incredibly skilled structure.
